instagram.caption:
Competition weekend? Bring your squares board with you. Swipe for the three step lobby trick.

Turn your board link into a QR code and print it on a sign for the lobby or the snack table. Dance parents scan, pick a square, done. Then post the same link in the studio group chat tonight.

Half the pot goes to the winner and half to competition fees, costumes or the nationals fund.

Link in bio. Save this tip for competition day.

#DanceMom #CompetitiveDance #DanceStudio #FundraisingIdeas #FootballSquares

defaults.footnote: Free to create. We never touch the money.
